projectDescription: Cross-platform filesystem notification library for Rust that provides real-time file and directory change events via native OS backends (inotify, FSEvents, kqueue, ReadDirectoryChangesW) with optional debouncing.
keyFeatures: Native OS backends: inotify (Linux/Android), FSEvents (macOS), kqueue (BSD/iOS), ReadDirectoryChangesW (Windows)
Rich event taxonomy: Create, Modify (data/metadata/name), Remove, Access, Other
Event kind filtering via EventKindMask for kernel-level noise reduction
Two debouncing layers: notify-debouncer-mini (lightweight) and notify-debouncer-full (smart rename stitching)
Async support via tokio, futures, crossbeam-channel, and flume
Serde serialization of events via optional feature flag
Batch path operations with update_paths() for efficient multi-path management
file-id utility for unique file identification across renames
publicApiSurface: trait Watcher { fn new(), watch(), unwatch(), update_paths(), configure(), watched_paths(), kind() }
struct Config { with_poll_interval(), with_compare_contents(), with_follow_symlinks(), with_event_kinds(), with_fsevent_latency(), with_windows_path_separator_style() }
struct Event { kind: EventKind, paths: Vec<PathBuf>, attrs: EventAttributes }
enum EventKind { Access, Create, Modify, Remove, Any, Other }
bitflags EventKindMask { ALL, CORE, CREATE, REMOVE, MODIFY_DATA, MODIFY_META, MODIFY_NAME, ALL_ACCESS }
enum ErrorKind { Generic, Io, PathNotFound, WatchNotFound, InvalidConfig, MaxFilesWatch }
enum WatcherKind { Inotify, Fsevent, Kqueue, PollWatcher, ReadDirectoryChangesWatcher, NullWatcher }
enum FileId { Inode { device_id, inode_number }, LowRes { volume_serial_number, file_index }, HighRes { ... } }
